questionText:

Faced with calls for her resignation, on the night of 25 June 1975, Indira Gandhi advised President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed to proclaim a National Emergency under Article 352 on the subjective grounds of 'internal disturbance'. Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
